title: Nothing but the Blood
lyrics: Verse 1:
[D]What can wash away my sin? [D]What can make me whole again?
[D]For my pardon this I see. [D]For my cleansing this my plea.
Chorus 1:
[C]Oh p[G]recious is th[D]e flow,
[C]That m[G]akes me white as[D] snow;
[C]No ot[G]her fou[D]nt I know,
[C]Nothing, nothi[G]ng, nothing b[D]ut the blood of Jesus.
Verse 2:
[D]For my cleansing this I see (nothing but the blood of Jesus)
[D]For my pardon this I bring (nothing but the blood of Jesus)
[D]Nothing can for sin atone, (nothing but the blood of Jesus)
N[D]aught of good that I have done (nothing but the blood of Jesus)
T[D]his is all my hope and peace (nothing but the blood of Jesus)
[D]This is all my righteousness (nothing but the blood of Jesus)
Bridge 1:
[C]Nothing, nothi[G]ng, nothing b[D]ut the blood of Jesus.
Verse 3:
[D]Now by this I'll overcome
[D]Now by this I'll reach my home
[D]Glory, glory, this I see (nothing but the blood of Jesus)
[D]All my praise for this I bring (nothing but the blood of Jesus) (last line 3x)
artist: Robert Lowry (Music by Jars of Clay)
